translations.web: Then he will turn his face toward the fortresses of his own land; but he will stumble and fall, and won’t be found.
translations.bsb: After this, he will turn back toward the fortresses of his own land, but he will stumble and fall and be no more.
translations.kjv: Then he shall turn his face toward the fort of his own land: but he shall stumble and fall, and not be found.
